sources.name: Cities and Towns
sources.meaning: Derived complete township coverage from exact union of official municipal/settlement partition polygons; not parcel designation or site-specific impact.
sources.geometryModified: Not supplied by layer; item modification is not a surveyed boundary date
sources.caveat: OBJECTID6 alone excludes named settlement polygons. Do not use original wilmot.geojson as whole-township coverage. Reconstruct with all9parts.
sources.derivation: @turf/union 7.4.0; no simplification, buffer or manual hole deletion. Input/output area match to 0.000266 square metres.

sources.name: Regional Boundary
sources.meaning: Administrative geography for region-wide policy; not project construction boundary
sources.caveat: Official metadata warns of known/suspected errors and differences with neighbouring municipal limits; not a legal survey

sources.name: Roads
sources.meaning: Derived corridor context joined from six unchanged official active centreline segments. Not an official project boundary, study area, or impact buffer.

sources.name: Addresses
sources.meaning: Live publicly queryable point-based address search for Waterloo Region. Licensed open data. No Esri paid geocoding service required.
